Name: Watermelon Tools for Content Patcher (CP)
Author: eorrl
Description:
This mod re-colours a bunch of tools & items to be pink and green (i.e. watermelon!). It is configurable so that your tools are mostly pink, mostly green, or a customized mix.

The affected tools are:
- All regular tools (hoe, axe, pickaxe, scythe, watering can)
- All fishing rods & the copper pan
- All trashcans
- The milking bucket & shears
- The return sceptre
- The horse flute
- The infinity blade

This mod should be unzipped directly into your Stardew Valley mods folder. After launching the game, a config file will be generated. You can set each category to "Pink", "Green", or "Vanilla". If you have Generic Mod Config Menu by spacechase0 installed, you could instead use that menu to set each category without restarting the game.

Note that the category "FishingTools" includes the fishing rods as well as the copper pan, and that "Other" includes the bucket, shears, and return sceptre. All of the others are individually customizable.

As of right now, unless you have the Iridium fishing rod, I would recommend setting "FishingTools" to "Vanilla", as this mod currently only changes the fishing rod's colour in your inventory, not while actually fishing. If you do have the Iridium fishing rod, it appears pink normally, so setting "FishingTools" to "Pink" works out well.

Hope you enjoy! :)

- Eorrl
